name stb (stb_vorbis, stb_truetype, stb_image, stb_image_write)
version 2c980bb (2026-08-02): stb_vorbis v1.22, stb_truetype v1.26, stb_image v2.30, stb_image_write v1.16
license MIT
licenseFile LICENSE
source https://github.com/nothings/stb
usedIn engine (Ogg Vorbis music, UI fonts and images, terrain heightmaps)
inGame yes
kept stb_vorbis.c, stb_truetype.h, stb_image.h, stb_image_write.h
why single-file public domain / MIT decoders: Ogg Vorbis for streamed music (through miniaudio), TrueType glyphs baked at run time for UI text, PNG for UI images and terrain heightmaps (decoded in the core for headless too); stb_image_write only for its deflate when the editor saves 16-bit heightmaps.
